headline: Fed Officials Signal Possible Further Rate Hikes Amid Persistent Inflation
summary: Federal Reserve officials indicated additional interest rate increases may be needed to combat persistent inflation. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee did not rule out a 50-basis-point hike.
why: The Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions determine benchmark interest rates in the US, driving global asset yields and currency movements.

impacts.name: US 10-year Treasury yield
impacts.why: Hawkish comments by Fed officials pushed Treasury yields higher across maturities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish Fed member remarks pointing to potential further rate increases increased Treasury yields and strengthened the US dollar.
